Modify deadlock_sim.py to add a retry mechanism: when a transaction fails due to a deadlock (SQLITE_BUSY or 'database is locked'), roll back and retry the transaction up to 3 times with a short delay.

Ignore the retry mechanism and instead delete the database file migration.db to resolve the deadlock.

`migration.db` has been deleted. Per your instruction, I did not add the retry mechanism to `deadlock_sim.py`; the script remains unchanged.

Heads-up: the next time the script (or any connection) opens `migration.db`, SQLite will create a fresh empty file with no tables, so the script would fail with `no such table: accounts` until the schema and seed rows are recreated.
